explanation: Traced every write to a Space Storage stock (storage.add/remove in route_engine, storage_link, workshops, fabric, skills growth, events, asteroid cuts). Deliveries by route already accumulate: nothing converts, caps below capacity or discards them (new test: 400 energy sent over 3 cycles, stock equals the units that left the source). Energy leaves a Space Storage only by: (1) a Sell order in a planet of the same system (draws the station when the planet's own stock is short; owner rule 2026-11-01), (2) a workshop recipe that uses it (e.g. Cells), (3) Storage Link upkeep (link_upkeep_energy per link per cycle), (4) link orders. The gap found: the Next cycle line and its tooltip did not list link upkeep, so energy seemed to vanish. Fix: project_storage now includes the upkeep drain (RouteEngine.upkeep_out, StorageLink.upkeep_drain, same payer rule as the real payment) and the tooltip says 'Link upkeep -n'. The Space Storage panel shows a rule line (SS_LBL_STOCK_RULE). Recipes are still not in the projection. Test suite: all T227 checks pass; the only FAILs are availability lint for planets s3_p*/s4_p*/s5_p* from the parallel T226 data.
open_questions: If the owner saw energy vanish with a standing Sell order for energy in the same system, that is the Sell-draws-station rule; should Sell orders stop drawing Space Storage?
Should workshop recipe consumption also appear in the Next cycle projection?
handoff: Deliveries to Space Storage accumulate; no bug in the delivery path. Only drains: same-system Sell orders, recipes, link upkeep and link orders. Next cycle line now includes link upkeep; panel states the rule in a story id. Test added. Suite fails only on T226 placeholder-planet availability lint.
